mapper.select: SELECT p.routing_node_id AS routingNodeId, COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_delta), 0) AS reportedQty FROM mes_execution_path_node p LEFT JOIN mes_production_report r ON r.execution_id = p.execution_id AND r.routing_node_id = p.routing_node_id WHERE p.execution_id = #{executionId} GROUP BY p.routing_node_id

SELECT r.id AS reportId, r.quantity_delta + COALESCE(SUM(a.quantity_delta), 0) AS effectiveQty FROM mes_production_execution e JOIN mes_production_report r ON r.execution_id = e.id LEFT JOIN mes_production_report a ON a.reference_report_id = r.id AND a.execution_id = e.id AND a.routing_node_id = r.routing_node_id WHERE e.id = #{executionId} AND r.id = #{reportId} GROUP BY r.id, r.quantity_delta

SELECT e.id AS executionId,e.workorder_id AS workorderId,e.routing_id AS routingId, e.target_qty AS targetQty,p.path_status AS pathStatus,COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_delta),0) AS lastNodeReportedQty, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(d.production_output_qty) FROM wm_stock_document d WHERE d.document_type='MATERIAL_ISSUE' AND d.production_request_id IS NOT NULL AND d.production_confirmation_status=#{inputSUCCEEDED} AND d.status='POSTED' AND d.source_execution_id=e.id AND d.production_input_kind='PRODUCTION_INPUT' AND d.production_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND d.production_stock_applied=TRUE AND COALESCE(d.production_void_result_status,'') NOT IN (#{inputSUBMITTING},#{inputUNKNOWN},#{inputSUCCEEDED}) AND d.production_source_mode=#{inputLOCAL_ONLY}),0) AS productionInputQty FROM mes_production_execution e LEFT JOIN mes_execution_path p ON p.id=e.id LEFT JOIN mes_execution_path_node n ON n.execution_id=e.id AND n.sequence_no=(SELECT MAX(last.sequence_no) FROM mes_execution_path_node last WHERE last.execution_id=e.id) LEFT JOIN mes_production_report r ON r.execution_id=e.id AND r.routing_node_id=n.routing_node_id WHERE e.workorder_id=#{workorderId} GROUP BY e.id,e.workorder_id,e.routing_id,e.target_qty,p.path_status ORDER BY e.id DESC
mapper.sql: FROM wm_stock_document d WHERE d.document_type='MATERIAL_ISSUE' AND d.production_request_id IS NOT NULL AND d.production_confirmation_status IN (#{inputSUCCEEDED},#{inputSUBMITTING},#{inputUNKNOWN}) AND d.status!='CANCELLED' AND d.production_input_kind='PRODUCTION_INPUT' AND (d.production_confirmation_status!=#{inputSUCCEEDED} OR (d.production_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND d.production_stock_applied=TRUE)) AND d.production_source_mode=#{inputLOCAL_ONLY}
mapper.select:
SELECT d.source_execution_id executionId, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.production_confirmation_status=#{inputSUCCEEDED} AND d.production_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND d.production_stock_applied=TRUE AND COALESCE(d.production_void_result_status,'')!=#{inputSUCCEEDED} THEN d.production_output_qty ELSE 0 END),0) AS confirmedQty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.production_confirmation_status IN (#{inputSUBMITTING},#{inputUNKNOWN}) OR d.production_void_result_status IN (#{inputSUBMITTING},#{inputUNKNOWN}) THEN d.production_output_qty ELSE 0 END),0) AS reservedQty
AND d.source_execution_id IN #{id} GROUP BY d.source_execution_id

SELECT p.execution_id executionId,p.routing_node_id routingNodeId,COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_delta),0) reportedQty FROM mes_execution_path_node p LEFT JOIN mes_production_report r ON r.execution_id=p.execution_id AND r.routing_node_id=p.routing_node_id WHERE p.execution_id IN #{id} GROUP BY p.execution_id,p.routing_node_id
